# judo-meta-asm

> Architecture Specific Model (ASM) metamodel for the JUDO platform — wraps Eclipse EMF Ecore with builder utilities, validation, FQN resolution, and OSGi/Eclipse integration.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ with Tycho 4.0.13 (Eclipse plugin builds), Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`)
- 6 modules: model, model-test, osgi, osgi-itest, feature, site
- Built on Eclipse EMF Ecore, Epsilon (EVL validation), Xtext/MWE2 (code generation), Lombok
- Fluent builder API generated from Ecore metamodel via MWE2 workflow into `model/src-gen/` (never hand-edit)
- CLI SPI integration for model validation and FQN resolution
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, module descriptions, and architecture diagrams
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, directory structure, key classes, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, code structure, troubleshooting, and submission guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Branch strategy, version numbers, and GitHub Actions workflows

## Modules — Core

- [model/](model/): Core Eclipse plugin — Ecore metamodel, hand-written runtime classes (AsmModel, AsmUtils, AsmEpsilonValidator), generated builders/helpers, EVL validation rules, and CLI SPI implementations
- [model-test/](model-test/): JUnit 5 tests for FQN resolution, builder API, validation engine, EAnnotation handling, and inheritance

## Modules — OSGi/Eclipse Packaging

- [osgi/](osgi/): Standalone OSGi bundle repackaging via Apache Felix Maven Bundle Plugin; exports all runtime packages
- [osgi-itest/](osgi-itest/): OSGi integration tests using Pax Exam with Apache Karaf container
- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature definition for plugin installation
- [site/](site/): Eclipse P2 update site for distribution

## Depends on

- [emf-genmodel-generator](../../eclipse/emf-genmodel-generator): Generates Builder pattern classes and helpers from EMF GenModel files
- [judo-cli-api](../judo-cli-api): CLI API contracts and caching layer decoupling CLI from metamodels
- [osgi-utils](../../runtime/osgi-utils): OSGi utility library — lifecycle tracking, config monitoring, ranked services
- [epsilon-runtime](../../tools/epsilon-runtime): Eclipse Epsilon runtime for Maven and OSGi environments

## Used by

- [judo-meta-expression-asm](../judo-meta-expression-asm): Bridges Expression metamodel with ASM for symbolic reference resolution
- [judo-meta-script](../judo-meta-script): Script metamodel — typed scripting language with ASM/ESM adapters
- [judo-model-cli](../../runtime/judo-model-cli): CLI for querying and transforming JUDO models via GraphQL
- [judo-operation-utils](../../runtime/judo-operation-utils): Base classes and collection operations for generated operation scripts
- [judo-platform](../../runtime/judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-runtime-core](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core): Multi-module runtime engine — data access, business logic, REST, and security
- [judo-runtime-core-esm-itest](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core-esm-itest): Integration tests for ESM-to-RDBMS transformation pipeline
- [judo-runtime-core-jsl](../../runtime/judo-runtime-core-jsl): JSL support for runtime core — model parsing through to DAOs and schema
- [judo-script-codegen](../../runtime/judo-script-codegen): Transpiles JCL scripts into executable Java source code
- [judo-sdk-common](../../runtime/judo-sdk-common): Base classes for generated SDK — entity identity, DAO base, and query filters
- [judo-services](../../runtime/judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container
- [judo-tatami](../../runtime/judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [judo-tatami-base](../../runtime/judo-tatami-base): PSM transformation pipeline — models to schemas, expressions, and configurations
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../../runtime/judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): CI/CD pipeline — version calculation, build, deploy, release

- [model/model/Ecore.ecore](model/model/Ecore.ecore): The Ecore metamodel definition that drives all code generation
